title: What came between Duchy of Prussia and Kingdom of Prussia?
question: What came between Duchy of Prussia and Kingdom of Prussia?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Duchy of Prussia (1525) to Kingdom of Prussia (1701): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.

records.description: former European state (1701–1918), part of the German Empire after 1871
